Shop Titans approaches the fantasy genre from a perspective rarely given much attention in traditional role-playing games. Instead of placing players in the boots of warriors, mages, or adventurers saving kingdoms from destruction, the game shifts focus toward the merchant standing behind the counter. Heroes still exist and continue battling monsters in dangerous locations, but they depend on someone to create and sell the equipment that keeps them alive. That responsibility falls to the player, transforming a simple shop into the foundation of an expanding business empire.

At first, the gameplay loop appears straightforward. Players craft items, place them on display shelves, and sell them to customers who enter the store looking for equipment. reviews.text:
Short version: if the company cared about the customer, they would give their in-game customer support the tools they need to help customers. However, after dealing with Support, it’s clear they are unable to do anything other than provide apologies.

I was ready to write this game a four-star, but after dealing with Support, I’ve made it one. If a game won’t respect your time, why are you going to give it your time? To anyone who reads this, you’re better off finding a game that puts the customer first. This is not one.

reviews.title: My favorite game! Edit: Was my favorite game 1/25/24
reviews.text: I dearly love this game. First off, I love that the creators respect their players enough to not overwhelm us with those annoying ads you have to watch in order to play. You have expansion packs and stuff packs essentially that enhance your game experience, but those are optional and not forced p2p. I’m more likely to purchase this way anyway. Second, the quality of the game is amazing. The creators are constantly enhancing the game play without loosing the purpose of the game. A lot of games can morph into something totally different and loose the original game that people loved in the process. The core game that people fell in love with is the same. Just enhanced. And finally, this game is downright fun. There is always something to do even when you’re waiting while crafting and questing. Adore this game. Edit 01/25/2024 I still love this game and have been playing for a very long time

reviews.title: Upgraded Items
reviews.text:
Please put an option to disable the extra window that pops up every time a higher quality item is obtained. PLEASE. It’s intensely annoying to get that especially when you’re making literally hundreds of items per day, it is not necessary for me to see every green and blue quality item that happens to pop up There needs to be something added to help make this a more active game. Like a clicker aspect or something that gives gold based on active game play.

It is absolutely asinine that we can’t sell items with enchantments. I whole heartedly desire for us to be capable of selling them.

reviews.title: Great game but major issues
reviews.text: Amazing game with lots of fun parts but two things greatly detract from your experience when playing. The first is that it starts to take more and more time for things to be finished the further you get in the game such as upgrading furniture or making items from blueprints at higher tiers. The second is the real issue which is that there is a HUGE paywall in this game for almost every available content and to make things worse they constantly remind you about it too. As a kind of last note, I have heard quite a bit about crashing issues but I personally haven’t encountered that much so I won’t discuss that problem further. Overall it’s fun to just try out for a bit but not really the kind of game I would like long term.

This game is very convenient with cross-save, and I do recommend. Me myself have spent more then I should have early on. So big tips to new players. Hit reddit to see whats worth buying before. Deals do look intriguing but you can also play without paying at all, multiple people in my guild don't pay and are just as far as me. Game is great with graphics and also very interactive I do wish you could add friends but enough opinions. The games great. Guilds are awesome and you can start your own or join ones already made. Customizing your shop and character are fun. And also building teams for quests. Highly recommend for people who like longterm invested games.
